pr_title: catalog: add support for moving reader catalogs timestamp forward for PCR
pr_body:
This patch adds logic for extracting and creating a PCR reader catalog. This patch will do the following:

1. Add a ReplicatedVersion field, which will allow us to determine if the timestamp can be advanced or the descriptor needs to be copied again
2. Set the Replicated field on the system database once a reader catalog is setup, so that schema changes are blocked


Fixes: #129664

issue_context.title: sql/catalog: prevent schema changes on replicated descriptors from reader catalog
issue_context.body:
As a part of the initial work we can use setup a reader catalog on a target tenant, which can access the data from a source tenant. Unfortunately, the initial work does not block schema changes, so its possible for the src tenant still to modify some of the objects. To address this we should track if descriptors are replicated by knowing the version in the source tenant, which can be later used to allow for refreshes of this information.



Jira issue: CRDB-41652

Epic CRDB-37521
